kept.reason: Guards races between concurrent runners: 20 processes ticked by 4 runners at once must each complete with one OrderPaid and exactly 20 calls/20 charges. a_step_run_but_not_recorded_is_replayed_not_repeated is a single crash-before-record replayed after a lease expires; no assertion there checks concurrent claiming, and folding the crash/lease setup into the parallel run would change what each checks and hide which behaviour failed.

kept_files.reason: Deep already: 8 public calls (submit, plan, state, history, start, process, tick, settle) hide idempotent replay, race retry (Races), snapshots, upcasting and dispatch; every event goes through the one private write(). Remaining smells are internal and small (process_state pass-through, record's 7 args), not worth a change at this churn.
